label: TheWaypoints
releaseNotes: 0.99 Beta 6: Tappable nearest/selected fields now show the POI name and category icon with a small outline pin and fixed Nearest POI/Selected POI header. Below it, the category icon and full wrapping POI name stay left and distance aligns right. Selected details remain visible without GPS. Descriptions explain that fields must be changed in the profile editor, with no long-press editing. Native numeric fields and valid extension startup remain. No migration or dependency change. Compact taps/sizing remain experimental. Based on the original Waypoints idea and codebase by Vadim Sinitskiy.
